shared_elements: low-relief carving on a tall vertical stone slab
horizontal registers or bands dividing the field
row of repeated rounded units at the top
raised outlined forms against a recessed ground
justification: Both are tall stone slabs worked in shallow relief, and both organise their surface into stacked horizontal registers, with a row of repeated rounded, arch-topped units near the top edge being the most specific correspondence. Beyond that they diverge sharply: A carries a few large, isolated naturalistic animal figures floating in open space, while B is filled edge-to-edge with a dense, strictly ruled grid of small compact abstract blocks, so the density, scale and subject of the carving are quite different.
